gaps.sentence: The missing files are still ___ investigation.
The new hall is ___ far the largest building on campus.
gaps.explanation: 'By far' strengthens a superlative: by far the largest.

gaps.sentence: The climbers were well ___ of schedule by midday.
She opened the letter ___ trembling hands.
The scheme paid off in the ___ — we recouped every euro.
The party is ___ the 14th, not the 21st.
The firm was put ___ liquidation by the end of March.
gaps.explanation: 'Put into liquidation' — the formal process of closing a company.'

gaps.sentence: Applications must be received ___ two weeks of the closing date.
gaps.explanation: 'Within two weeks' = not later than two weeks after.
